architectural_role: atomic session admission and budget reservation
expected_failure_mode: mid-session cascade, wasted work, no commitment-issued signal
observed_failure_mode: disabling commitment removes commitment-issued signal and degrades completion/cascade behavior in controlled workloads
observed_signal: wo_commitment has zero commitment-issued signal; cascade_failed higher vs full
interpretation_boundary: strong_controlled evidence in p3 workload; bws_v3 extends to larger matrix
paper_claim_allowed: session commitment protects session-level admission semantics and reduces mid-session waste under controlled overload
paper_claim_not_allowed: does not prove raw-success dominance in every workload

architectural_role: adapt capacity admission under overload while avoiding strict always-on rejection
expected_failure_mode: strict over-rejects; no-capacity admits into overload and increases cascade/wasted work
observed_failure_mode: no-capacity can increase raw success but produces much higher cascade and wasted_service_ms; adaptive/strict bound waste through admission
observed_signal: no_capacity_step0 has higher cascade_failed and wasted_service_ms vs adaptive/strict
interpretation_boundary: trade-off visible in bws_v3 full sensitivity sweep; provider elasticity changes interpretation (see provider_boundary)
paper_claim_allowed: adaptive capacity admission exposes and controls the admission-vs-waste trade-off
paper_claim_not_allowed: does not prove adaptive always beats strict in raw success

architectural_role: preserve completed ReAct progress after recoverable interruption
expected_failure_mode: recoverable ReAct interruption cannot resume; replay waste remains
observed_failure_mode: recovery probes show current_step>0 and avoided_replay_steps>0 after real resume
interpretation_boundary: targeted probe confirms checkpoint mechanics; system experiments confirm integration
paper_claim_allowed: ReAct checkpointing preserves completed progress for client-cooperative resume
paper_claim_not_allowed: gateway does not automatically execute future tools

architectural_role: expose a safe resume point and require client continuation
expected_failure_mode: checkpoint exists but client cannot safely continue remaining steps
observed_failure_mode: real resume responses return recovered=true, react_client_cooperative mode, current_step>0, and post_resume_success>0 in system experiments
interpretation_boundary: proves client-cooperative protocol works in integrated system; does not prove server-only auto-recovery
paper_claim_allowed: recovery resume protocol enables real client-cooperative continuation after recoverable interruption
paper_claim_not_allowed: does not prove automatic server-side recovery

architectural_role: distinguish hard backend capacity from elastic provider behavior
disabled_or_control_variant: cloud backend smoke / cloud provider backend
